subject: All ten done, board 13 -> 16, and C1.2 was only earnable after fixing the ordering
body:
All ten items you listed are done. Board went 13 met to 16 while you were out.

Earned today: C2.3, C5.7, C1.2.

THE LAST TWO:

Session TP/SL — retired, not built. I was going to make the dimension real, then measured the
cells first: 22 of the 36 session-by-regime cells fall below your own 1,030 sample floor. Noise
has FIVE bars in the entire 50,000-bar history. Controlled Pullback has 83. Splitting an already
sparse partition four more ways would have produced "calibrations" fitted to a handful of trades.
That is not a missing feature, it is an unaffordable one, and it is now documented as such.

C1.2 — one authoritative regime classifier, precedence declared. This is the one I am happiest
with, because it was only EARNABLE today. Yesterday the declaration would have been a lie: your
base regime and enhanced regime could describe different bars, because one was assigned at the top
of the tick and the other at the bottom. Fixing that ordering first (WARRANT#347) made an honest
declaration possible; then I wrote it.

The declaration carries the rule that caused FIVE separate defects in the last day: a [9] table
takes g_RegimeState.currentRegime, a [12] table takes engine.regime, and both are plain int so the
compiler will never catch a swap. That is now written at the classifier instead of being
rediscovered a sixth time.

THREE THINGS I RETIRED RATHER THAN WIRED, all on measurement:
- the hysteresis band (RG-18 says your classifier does not flicker)
- the session TP/SL dimension (the cells cannot carry it)
- partial profits (defaulted off, so reviving sizing did not silently switch on a winner-cutter)

WATCH THESE ON THE NEXT RUN: sizing is alive again, the bearish classifier path is now symmetric
with the bullish one, and regime 8 is reachable for the first time — so Controlled Pullback will
start appearing in live classification where it never has.

Eight criteria left: C1.1, C1.6, C2.1, C3.1, C3.2, C4, C6.1, C8.5. C1.6 looks like the same shape
as C1.2 and may be earnable the same way. Continuing.
